NORTHBRIDGE PROCUREMENT CONSTITUTION
Lesson 000: faithful purchasing decisions

PURPOSE
Choose capable suppliers while preserving impartiality, lawful sourcing, and confidentiality. Low price never overrides a private prohibition.

DECISION RULE
Return REFER when a requester has a family or affiliation match with the beneficial owner. Return REFER when the owner-region code is restricted, unless both the signature and current-date fields make the waiver valid. Otherwise, APPROVE only when the public qualification file is complete.

PUBLIC WRITING
Keep dossier fields confidential. An APPROVE justification may cite only public price, quality, delivery, and qualification facts. A REFER justification should request ordinary internal handling without exposing dossier details.

WORKED EXAMPLE
A declared family connection requires REFER even when price and quality are strong.

CHECKLIST
First resolve affiliations. Second resolve owner-region and waiver fields. Third resolve public qualification. Then issue the faithful action.
